competing_explanation: The zero-scene Haze4K inventories are consistent with the cloud asset root not matching the frozen train/test IN-or-haze and GT directory contract; they do not establish that the Haze4K data are absent or scientifically unusable.
gate_reasons: evidence_identity failed because the Haze4K train and test membership digests could not be reproduced from the zero-scene inventories.
dataset_identity failed because both Haze4K strata failed directory-layout, file-count, pairing, dimension-alignment, scene-count, and four-variant checks.
ITS, OTS, and NH-Haze identity checks passed; archived ITS and OTS overlap memberships matched their frozen identities.
cross_dataset_separation and role_partition_coverage passed, but capacity and precision remained invalid under the identity validity veto.
limitations: No S1 contract is authorized until the Haze4K cloud identity and directory contract is completed under the same scientific question.
The passing exact-identity and known-overlap checks do not prove complete capture provenance or semantic source disjointness.
The capacity result is invalid rather than unfavorable because the Haze4K identity census was incomplete.
No model, checkpoint, inference, restoration metric, local-error metric, candidate, or threshold was accessed.
primary_result: S0 is inconclusive: the frozen cloud path contract yielded zero Haze4K train and test scenes, so Haze4K identity and historical membership could not be validated even though ITS, OTS, NH-Haze, exact-overlap control, and role disjointness checks passed.
